description: Headless facade that fronts the FFC tool of NXP S32 Configuration Tools via `nxp_s32ct_execute_action(action_name="s32ct.configure_ffc", params={...})`. Triggers when users ask to import AUTOSAR ARXML (`.ecvd`) files or JSON, restrict the FFC `-FileType` to `all|Fss_Rem_Pm|Fss_Btm`, fill default containers, validate the configuration, or export ARXML / JSON / MEX from a `.mex` project. Delegates shared launcher and plumbing (workspace `-data`, `s32ct_launcher`, `launcher_ini`, `timeout_s`, retry-on-`IllegalStateException`) to the generic `s32ct-cli` skill. Keywords: FFC, AUTOSAR, ARXML, `.ecvd`, JSON, `-defaultContainers`, `-Validate`, ExportARXML, ExportJSON, ExportMEX.
